content.short: TonBit, a BitsLab subsidiary, provides TON infrastructure and security audits, including Tact and FunC language audits.
content.description: TonBit focuses on safeguarding the TON ecosystem through infrastructure and security audits of its networks and components. Since 2021, TonBit has contributed to TON blockchain research and development to simplify building on the platform with scalable solutions. The team conducts thorough code, design, and deployment reviews and provides actionable recommendations to strengthen security. TonBit carries out audits of the TON smart contract languages, including Tact and FunC, helping projects identify vulnerabilities and improve resilience in production.
content.meta: TonBit is a BitsLab security division focused on TON infrastructure and audits. Discover TonBit and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
